reviews.title: Abysmal app
reviews.text: App takes your money and then holds you ransom while subjecting you to watching and casting judgment over multiple movie samples just to get to where you may be able to watch the movie you came to see. Wade in carefully.

reviews.title: Cannot cancel auto renewal with a full refund
reviews.text: I got auto-charged the annual premium (FULL PRICE) with no warning containing an updated recurring yearly payment reminder.  I unexpectedly, and at a rather unfortunate time, saw the pending charge on my bank account yesterday.  I tried to cancel but a full refund is not given (not even a partial refund).  It renewed yesterday.  For a company that claims to “Amplify Light” and has a great way to spread the love of Jesus, this is a shady business practice.    I cannot even reach a human to talk to.  Just an automated email message system.  I was going to see if I could possibly move to monthly because it was a huge financial hit.  I can’t even do that.  Please beware.  It is 2026, sad to see this is a thing from a really cool and positive streaming app that I feel safe sharing with my little family.  Will someone please contact me to help rectify this situation?  I really want to give 5 stars because I love this App and content, but this is really sad to see.

reviews.title: THEY DON’T REPRESENT THE FAITH. THEY’RE REVIEW FARMING (ILLEGAL)
reviews.text:
THEY ONLY BILL ANNUALLY!!!!!!!!!!!!For a faith based streaming service I can tell you that this is BY A MILE the most deceptive in its subscription options. Don’t believe me? I can show you at least 1,000 people that had the same experience I did. They charged me about $150 for the initial subscription. I didn’t think I would have to read the subscription options so carefully but boy was I wrong. The way it’s presented it deceiving and manipulative in its appearance. “Oh you should read the fine print”. Forgive me if I let my guard down while I’m trying to watch movies and series about God. What streaming service makes you commit to a YEAR of subscription??? 
Now my goal is to make sure everyone can stream their platform for free. I knew how to do to begin with but I genuinely wanted to support them. Now I’m dedicated to making sure they don’t get a singular subscriber, every one WILL consumer their content for free and they WILL NOT be able to do a thing about it.

I actually love the content and selection. My issue is that I cannot watch some movies, like Redemption River. They won’t load and the spinning wheel just goes on forever.
